FNC.description: Driscoll and Braun, Fundamentals of Numerical Computation. Consult chapters on linear least squares, roots, IVPs, BVPs and diffusion. Reference only.

DOE.description: US DOE, Fundamentals Handbook, Thermodynamics, Heat Transfer, and Fluid Flow, vol. 3, DOE-HDBK-1012/3-92. Fluid flow and Bernoulli/system head sections. Original illustrations only.

BL.description: MIT, Summary of Boundary Layer over a Flat Plate. Hydrodynamic similarity and local versus integrated measures. Consult as a scientific reference.

BLASIUS.description: Blasius, The Boundary Layers in Fluids with Little Friction, translation of the 1908 paper. Historical similarity problem.

HEAT.description: J. H. Lienhard V and IV, A Heat Transfer Textbook, 6th ed., v6.00 (2024). Steady and transient conduction, forced convection and heat exchangers. Copyrighted, limited personal/nonprofit instructional use.

POHL.description: E. Pohlhausen (1921), Der Wärmeaustausch zwischen festen Körpern und Flüssigkeiten mit kleiner Reibung und kleiner Wärmeleitung. Thermal boundary-layer source, DOI 10.1002/zamm.19210010205.

COLE.description: C. F. Colebrook (1939), Turbulent flow in pipes, with particular reference to the transition region between the smooth and rough pipe laws. Distinguish smooth-to-rough transition from laminar-to-turbulent transition.

ROUGH.description: Colebrook and White (1937), Experiments with fluid friction in roughened pipes. DOI 10.1098/rspa.1937.0150. Original experimental context; rights to reproduce data require review.

PUMP.description: US DOE, Improving Pumping System Performance, 2nd ed. Pump and system interaction, operating costs and vendor duty evidence.

MIT.description: MIT OCW 10.302 Transport Processes, Fall 2004, syllabus and references. Transport teaching sequence.

FOG.description: H. S. Fogler, Elements of Chemical Reaction Engineering, companion site. Consult Conversion and Reactor Sizing, Isothermal Reactor Design, Nonisothermal Reactor Design and RTD sections.

IUPAC.description: IUPAC Gold Book, Arrhenius equation, DOI 10.1351/goldbook.A00446. Terms have individual licensing; use own explanation.

THERMO.description: LearnChemE, Thermodynamics 1 simulations. Compare real versus ideal gas, cycles and phase behaviour.

SEP.description: Lamm and Jarboe, Chemical Engineering Separations: A Handbook for Students. Equilibrium, separations and graphical design. Check section-level licence and third-party images.

MCC.description: W. L. McCabe and E. W. Thiele (1925), Graphical Design of Fractionating Columns. DOI 10.1021/ie50186a023. Reference only.

TRAY.description: LearnChemE, McCabe–Thiele Method for Methanol/Water Separation. Comparison of existing instructional scope.

FILTER.description: L. García-Triñanes, Particle Technology, Filtration lecture (2019), University of Twente course copy. Cake/medium resistance. Reference only.

PID.description: APMonitor Process Dynamics and Control, Proportional Integral Derivative. Anti-reset windup and controller conventions.

GUM.description: JCGM 100:2008, Evaluation of measurement data — Guide to the expression of uncertainty in measurement. Sections on combined standard uncertainty, correlated inputs.

MC.description: JCGM 101:2008, Supplement 1 to the GUM, propagation of distributions using a Monte Carlo method.

STAT.description: NIST/SEMATECH e-Handbook of Statistical Methods, datasets and statistical methods. Inspect dataset-specific provenance.

NORRIS.description: NIST Norris additional information. Origin is an ozone-monitor calibration study; independent from Furmtech equipment.

ERGUN.description: S. Ergun (1952), Fluid flow through packed columns, Chemical Engineering Progress 48, 89–94. Coefficients and geometry require qualification.

RM.description: W. E. Ranz and W. R. Marshall Jr. (1952), Evaporation from drops, Parts I and II, Chemical Engineering Progress 48, 141–146, 173–180. Bibliographic retrospective; original experimental envelope to clear.

BIO.description: Biochemical Engineering, Wiley-VCH, DOI 10.1002/9783527684984. Bioreactor fundamentals, growth and transport. Copyrighted.

MM.description: Johnson and Goody (2011), The original Michaelis constant: translation of the 1913 Michaelis–Menten paper.

LANG.description: I. Langmuir (1918), The adsorption of gases on plane surfaces of glass, mica and platinum. DOI 10.1021/ja02242a004.
